description: A chemical company is transporting their hydrogen using two different methods, high pressure tube trailers and liquefied hydrogen tankers. The first method is a high-pressure tube trailer which can transport 50 cubic meters each per trip at a cost of $500. The second method is using liquefied hydrogen tankers which can transport 30 cubic meters each per trip at a cost of $200. The company needs to transport at least 1000 cubic meters of hydrogen and they have budget of $3750 available. In addition, the number of transports done by the high pressure tube trailer method has to be less than the number of transports done by the liquefied hydrogen tanker method. How many of each transportation method should they use to minimize the total number of trips?

TransportCapacity.definition: Transport capacity per trip for each transportation method

TransportCost.definition: Transport cost per trip for each transportation method

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of transportation trips using both methods"
objective.code: model.setObjective(quicksum(NumTrips[i] for i in range(NumTransportMethods)), GRB.MINIMIZE)

constraints.description: The total hydrogen transported by all trips must be at least 1000 cubic meters
constraints.code:
model.addConstr(
    sum(TransportCapacity[m] * NumTrips[m] for m in range(NumTransportMethods)) 
    >= MinimumHydrogen
)

constraints.description: The total transportation cost must not exceed 3750 dollars
The number of high-pressure tube trailer trips must be less than the number of liquefied hydrogen tanker trips
The number of trips for each transportation method must be a non-negative integer

NumTrips.definition: Number of trips using each transportation method
